title: Black holes with quantum corrections in $3d$: The case of Page curve in Lindblad, greybody factor, and Lyapunov exponent
summary: In this work, first we discuss black holes with quantum corrections as an open quantum system and apply Lindblad formalism to explain the ``zig-zag" behavior in the Hawking- Page curve and radiation process, specially by considering the effects of exceptional points. Then, we calculate quantum corrections for various parameters of $3d$ Cotler-Jensen theory which is $\text{AdS}_3$ with reparametrized modes.
